item.title: REPORT | Charlton Athletic 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC claimed a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at the Valley after Ollie Rathbone’s first-half volley. Not much separated the two sides in the opening exchanges until Rathbone popped up with a moment of magic to score his seventh goal of the season after 30 minutes. Charlton battled hard to try and find an equaliser, with the game finely poised heading into the closing stages. item.title: PHIL PARKINSON | “We showed incredible resilience to get the win”
item.description: Wrexham AFC manager Phil Parkinson heralded his side’s backs-to-the-wall defensive effort to see out victory away to Charlton Athletic. The Red Dragons claimed victory at The Valley, with Ollie Rathbone’s brilliant first-half volley the difference on the scoresheet. item.title: FOOTBALL v HOMOPHOBIA | No place for hate at Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC are proud to have joined our fellow EFL clubs in using the official rainbow ball at our recent league matches in support of Football v Homophobia. Our home matches against Ipswich Town and Portsmouth, and our away match against Charlton Athletic, all saw the rainbow ball and rainbow corner flags used. item.title: TICKET NEWS | Watford (A) on sale from Wednesday March 4
item.description: Tickets for our away fixture against Watford on Tuesday March 17, will go on sale to supporters from Wednesday March 4. We have been allocated 2,258 tickets for the match at Vicarage Road, which kicks off at 7:45pm. Tickets will go on sale to season-ticket holders at 10am.
